utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds lovely, Dane. I’d be glad to join the book club.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s great to hear. I’ll make sure to bring something good for the first meeting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s kind of you, Dane. I’m looking forward to it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. I can bring a few options for the next book.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That works for me. Could you bring a couple of titles that are a bit different from each other so we have some variety?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I’ll bring two that are pretty different.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I heard the book club’s meeting moved to Thursday, so I’m bringing the extra copies then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, Thursday. I almost missed that, but I’ll try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for you on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t read that one yet, but I’d be open to hearing what you liked about it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven’t started it yet, so I should probably check the library copy and make sure I can get there on time before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. If you can get the library copy and make it there on time, I’d say that’s probably the easiest way to decide.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we meeting at the library or the cafe for book club?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it’s at the library, but I’d check with someone who knows for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, I’ll check with someone who knows for sure.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club might be changing the meeting night. I’ll ask around and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around at the store and see if anyone knows for sure. If it changes, I’ll make sure you hear about it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I just heard the book club’s meeting is getting moved to Thursday evening. You should come with me if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thursday evening works for me. Where’s it meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s at my place, over on Maple Street near the corner cafe. I’ll send you the exact address.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help with the book club. What are you reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What are you reading, exactly? I just want to make sure this is the right book before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m reading this month’s pick, *The Midnight Library*. If that’s the right one for the club, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo. I’ve got the book club list ready, and I can pull together a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just send me the time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll send you the time as soon as I finalize it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the book club. Let’s pick a time and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Tuesday evening works for me. I can bring a short list of titles, and you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Tuesday evening works for me. I’ll spread the word and let people know to bring their title ideas too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club. I think I said I’d bring something, didn’t I?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think so. I can bring tea, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can bring the snacks, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club’s been picking up lately - have you read this month’s pick yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I’ve heard good things about it. What’s your take so far?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m about halfway in, and it’s been a solid pick so far - thoughtful without feeling too heavy.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come by the book club this week, Dane. I think you'd like the discussion.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can come by this week.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven't heard much about it yet, but I'd be glad to listen if you want to tell me what's planned.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — it’s this Thursday at the community center, and we’re starting with short introductions before picking the next book.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds straightforward; I might stop by and hear what everyone’s thinking about.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can help with that book club. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: How about Thursday at 7? That should give everyone time to get there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at 7 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds fun, Vik. I can ask around and see who else wants to join the book club.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That sounds good, Jules. Let’s see who else wants to join and then we can pick a book.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Vik. I’ll check with a few more people and then we can choose a book.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my folding chairs if the book club needs a few extra.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. That should help with seating.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll bring them over for the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check which library has the meeting notes and let Rosa know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal. Let me know what you find, and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the library and let you know as soon as I have the notes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we meeting at the library, or is the book club somewhere else?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think it’s at the community center this time, but let me check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, let’s wait for the details before we decide.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, I can help with the book club.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then I’ll bring the sign-up sheet and confirm what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I’ll check in on the rest and we can split up whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I just heard the book club's meeting got moved, but I don't know the new time yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, I must've missed that. Do you know if they picked a new time yet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet, just that it got shifted. I’m trying to find out the new time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the book club meeting is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on. I heard they’re meeting at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still at the usual time, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting got moved to Thursday evening. Are you still planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I should be there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, see you there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club. I think we said Tuesday, unless I’m mixing it up with something else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tuesday sounds right. I’ll check with the others and make sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks. I’ll look out for your update and see you Tuesday.
